mapper.select: SELECT ddovyo.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.user_source, t.total_online_time, t.total_user_num, t.new_user_online_time, t.new_user_num FROM (SELECT duo.dates, duo.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow') user_source, IFNULL(sum(duo.online_time), 0) total_online_time, IFNULL(count(DISTINCT duo.user_id), 0) total_user_num, IFNULL(sum(case when dui.user_id is not null then duo.online_time end), 0) new_user_online_time, IFNULL(count(DISTINCT case when dui.user_id is not null then dui.user_id end), 0) new_user_num FROM dwd_user_online duo LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (duo.user_id = dui.user_id and dui.dates = duo.dates) left join dim_user_source dus on (duo.user_id = dus.user_id) where duo.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duo.dates, duo.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_usrc_online ddovyo on (t.dates = ddovyo.dates and t.pkg = ddovyo.pkg and t.user_source = ddovyo.user_source)
